item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / bla ma rje la mthol lo bshags/ ma mkha' 'gro gnyen la bzod par gsol/ 'di bzhengs dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ nam mkhas khyab tshad 'gro ba rnams/ bdag med dbyings su sangs rgyas shog kha ba can ljongs bod yul du/ 'phrul ngag bden pa g.yung drung bon/ bdag gi bka' yi gdam pa 'di/ mkha' la nyi shar ci bzhin du/ mi nub yongs khyab bkra shis shog/
